card.name: Methotrexate and/or its metabolite
card.fires_on: The word "its" (or "/or" in "and/or") right after methotrexate, just before the word metabolite. It appears in proton pump inhibitor interaction warnings.

modes.label: its after methotrexate
modes.description: The word "its" follows "methotrexate and/or" and comes just before "metabolite".
modes.example: Concomitant use with PPIs may elevate and/or prolong serum concentrations of methotrexate and/or<< its>> metabolite, possibly leading to toxicity.

modes.label: /or in and/or
modes.description: The "/or" piece of "and/or" after methotrexate, just before "its metabolite".
modes.example: Concomitant use with PPIs may elevate and/or prolong serum concentrations of methotrexate and<</or>> its metabolite, possibly leading to toxicity

card.plain: It marks the spot in methotrexate interaction warnings where the text refers to the drug's metabolite.
